@graph.name: APCO Infratech 13 MW Turnkey Power Sanction & Dual 6.5 MW Express Feeders
@graph.description: Landmark 13 MW turnkey industrial power infrastructure project in Bhiwandi sourced across two distinct transmission hubs (100kV Substation and 220kV EHV Grid Substation), dual 6.5 MW express feeder lines, vacuum circuit breakers, dual-incomer synchronization, and statutory commissioning under the Electrical Inspector.

mainEntity.name: What statutory approvals are required from the Electrical Inspector (PWD) for HT installations and D.G. sets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Under Regulation 43 of the Central Electricity Authority (CEA) Safety Regulations and Section 54 of the Electricity Act, any High Tension (HT) installation (11kV, 22kV, 33kV) and Diesel Generator (D.G.) set must undergo drawing approval, physical inspection, earth resistance verification, and interlock checking by the Electrical Inspector (PWD) before charging. Gayatri Electrical Services handles drawing submissions, Form A/B clearances, and complete liaisoning to obtain official charging permissions.

mainEntity.name: What HT and LT electrical contracting services do you provide under Torrent Power and MSEDCL jurisdictions?

acceptedAnswer.text: As a licensed Govt. Authorized Electrical Contractor, we execute turnkey HT and LT contracting across Torrent Power (Bhiwandi Circle) and MSEDCL (Mahavitaran). Our services include new HT/LT service connections, load enhancements, overhead and underground cable laying, substation erection, transformer commissioning, Express Feeder execution, and CT/PT metering cubicle testing.

mainEntity.name: Which manufacturing and process industries do you provide electrical infrastructure for?

acceptedAnswer.text: We provide specialized power solutions for heavy manufacturing and continuous process plants, including Printing & Packaging, Irrigation & Agricultural Piping, Rubber & Polymer Manufacturing, Office Furniture & Precision Components, Chemical & Bulk Drug Plants (flameproof FLP), Textiles & Auto-Looms, Cold Storage & Ammonia Compressors, and Stone Quarries.

mainEntity.name: Why is it mandatory to hire a Govt. Authorized Electrical Contractor in Maharashtra?

acceptedAnswer.text: By law under Indian Electricity Rules, execution, testing, and certification of HT installations, substations, and lifts must be carried out by a licensed contractor authorized by the State Government Licensing Board (Govt. of Maharashtra) to ensure statutory safety compliance and valid utility energization.

mainEntity.name: What is the procedure for obtaining D.G. Set (Diesel Generator) approval from the Electrical Inspector (PWD)?

acceptedAnswer.text: D.G. set approval requires formal single-line diagram (SLD) approval, physical inspection, earth pit resistance testing (separate neutral and body earthing), acoustic enclosure verification, and electrical/mechanical interlock validation to prevent backfeeding to the utility grid. We prepare all drawings, file Form A/B submissions, and secure final charging permission.

mainEntity.name: How do you help manufacturing plants avoid Low Power Factor (PF) penalties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Operating below 0.90 power factor results in heavy monthly utility penalties, while maintaining PF above 0.95 yields bill incentives. We design, install, and calibrate Automatic Power Factor Correction (APFC) panels with detuned harmonic filters to counter harmonics generated by VFDs, extrusion motors, and welding equipment.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) for industrial substations, transformers, and HT/LT panels?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we provide Comprehensive and Non-Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) covering HT substations, transformer oil filtration, BDV dielectric testing, VCB/SF6 breaker servicing, protection relay calibration, LT distribution panels, APFC capacitor bank maintenance, and earth pit audits across Bhiwandi, Kudus, Wada, and Thane.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide emergency breakdown assistance for industrial transformers and HT panels?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we provide rapid-response emergency electrical services for industrial clients across Bhiwandi, Kudus, Wada, Thane, and Mumbai for transformer overhauls, on-site BDV dielectric oil testing, high-vacuum oil filtration, HT cable fault location & jointing, and switchgear repairs.

mainEntity.name: Which industrial areas and regions in Maharashtra do you serve?

acceptedAnswer.text: We actively serve industrial and commercial clients throughout Bhiwandi (Sonale, Val, Mankoli, Padgha, Bhadwad, Dapoda, Rahnal), the Kudus and Wada industrial corridors, Thane, Kalyan, Dombivli, Ambernath, Badlapur, Shahapur, Navi Mumbai, and the wider Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR).

mainEntity.name: What are your pricing terms and accepted payment methods?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gayatri Electrical Services is a legally registered GST engineering firm adhering to statutory compliance. We provide transparent, competitive project estimates based on an itemized engineering Bill of Quantities (BOQ). All contracting transactions, milestone disbursements, and AMC retainers are billed through formal GST Tax Invoices and settled via institutional banking channels: Bank Transfer (RTGS / NEFT / IMPS), Account Payee Cheques, or Verified Corporate UPI. This guarantees 100% financial audit compliance and ensures that corporate clients can claim full GST Input Tax Credit (ITC).
